Hi Lena / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. I'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align owners, technical milestones, and a proposed close window for your evaluation of Redwood Inference. Per our conversation, the key goals are:

- Validate latency & cost for your query shapes on our hosted offering (1–2 model variants)
- Run a focused pilot with an anonymized dataset for 2 weeks
- Exercise security controls (audit logs, VPC connector) and finalize procurement

Introductions: Hiro is our Solutions Engineer for this engagement (technical lead). Marissa will support onboarding and pilot ops.

Hiro — meet the Datasail team: Lena (Head of Product) and Priya (Ops/IT). Lena / Priya — meet Hiro and Marissa.

I attached a 1-page MAP draft (Datasail_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short technical checklist that Hiro will follow up on. Proposed high-level timeline (open to adjustments):

- 2026-11-02: Test capacity provisioned and sample dataset ingested
- 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-16: Pilot evaluation window
- Week of 2026-11-20: Pricing and SLA review; procurement next steps

Can you confirm owners (technical & procurement) and 30 minutes for a kickoff next week? I'm available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT and Thu 2–4 PT.

Next steps: once we lock the kickoff we'll update the MAP doc with exact deliverables and a shared Jira epic.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the intros, Diego / Lena. Quick tech checklist so we can make the kickoff productive; I'm attaching a short checklist (redwood_technical_checklist.md) but listing the highlights below: 

1) Networking
- IP ranges we'll call out for outbound allowlist (I'll need your egress IPs or confirm if you'll use a VPC connector)
2) Data
- We'll accept an anonymized sample (CSV/JSON). Please aim for ~1k representative queries to start.
3) Model/config
- Which model family do you want us to run (open-llama-13B / redwood-instruct-7B / other)? If unsure, we can propose 2 to A/B during the pilot.
4) Traffic profile
- Expected QPS, median sequence length, and burst tolerance. This will determine batching/caching settings.
5) Security
- Desired log retention (30/90/365 days) and whether you need audit export to your S3/KMS.

If Samir can paste the answers to (1),(2),(4),(5) we can pre-provision a sandbox and have basic telemetry in place by 2026-11-02.

Attachments: redwood_technical_checklist.md

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@datasail.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@datasail.ai>

Subject: Re: Cross-functional MAP kickoff & technical intro (timeline + owners)

Hiro / team —

Thanks — quick answers inline: 

(1) Networking: We'll use an internal NAT egress; IPs are 54.210.12.34 and 54.210.12.35 (will confirm with infra). If you support a VPC connector later that's fine.
(2) Data: We'll provide an anonymized JSON payload set (1,200 examples) by 2026-10-30. Format: {"user_text": "...", "context": {"item_id": "..."}} — let me know if you need schema changes.
(3) Model: Start with redwood-instruct-7B and a quantized 4-bit variant for cost testing; happy to test open-llama-13B if latency looks good.
(4) Traffic profile: Baseline ~8 QPS, bursts up to 40 QPS; median seq len ~120 tokens.
(5) Security: We need 90-day log retention initially and an export to our S3 bucket (details to follow).

I've created an internal Jira epic for the pilot: https://jira.datasail.ai/browse/DS-EPIC-87 — I'll link any infra tickets there.

Wed 11:00 PT for the kickoff works for me. Looking forward to the agenda: 1) provisioning and connectivity, 2) test payload ingestion, 3) acceptance criteria for pilot.

— Samir Patel
Engineering Lead, Datasail.ai
